calibration_note: temperature scaling fitted on the calibration split (4000000 pixels, 200 images); ECE overall 0.0088 -> 0.0093, foreground 0.1946 -> 0.1866 (fit scope: all)

provenance.note: Built by the release workflow for validation.

limitations: Estimates visible image coverage only; not contamination by weight or bale purity.
Trained on one facility's paper-stream conveyor (ZeroWaste-f); not validated elsewhere.
Recognizes four materials: cardboard, soft plastic, rigid plastic, metal.
A background prediction does not certify that material is absent.
